abstract: We present a Sora-scale video synthesis architecture unifying Diffusion Transformers, 3D Rotary Positional Embeddings with low-frequency temporal allocation and diagonal layout, spatio-temporal latent patchification via deep compression 3D VAE, and rectified flow matching for straight-path, simulation-free training. Our system achieves 720p 128-frame generation in 20 Heun steps with superior temporal consistency and world-simulator properties.
